svg.aria-label: A swimlane of next build at v16.4.0. Top lane, the JS orchestrator in build/index.ts, shows nine boxes in source order with the line where each opens: clean at 1381, which wipes .next but keeps cache, dev, diagnostics, lock and trace; discover-routes at 1555, which reads app/ in JS; a red marker for validateAppPaths at 1635, which has no span; generate-route-types at 1650, writing .next/types; generate-routes-manifest at 1786, computed before compile and written at 3076; compile at 1889, the branch; TypeScript, serial after compile; static-check at 2349; static-generation at 3214, writing HTML, RSC and segment files and then the prerender manifest; and write-route-bundle-stats at 4839, Turbopack only. Orange measured labels give compile 25.2 s, TypeScript 13.8 s, static generation 21.7 s with 7 workers, and a whole-build wall of 70.4 s, for the 401-route app. Below, app/ on disk feeds both discover-routes and Turbopack's get_directory_tree, so the tree is read twice. A purple note says cache/ survives clean so the next build starts warm. A red note says validateAppPaths erases parameter names, rejecting /blog/[id] with /blog/[slug] but passing /[a]/x with /[b]/y. Inside compile, exactly one lane runs. Turbopack: get_directory_tree as one memoised task per directory, walk_tree emitting each LoaderTree as JS text, one server file per page such as server/app/sec0/a/[id]/page.js, and per-page app-paths manifests merged into 405 keys. Webpack: createEntrypoints with server entry app/sec0/a/[id]/page and no client entry for App pages, then server, edge-server and client compiles, with a dashed purple arc showing the server compile's injectedClientEntries feeding the client compile. Bottom lane, next start at boot: setupFsCheck sorts dynamic routes with the deprecated getSortedRoutes, and for /[a]/x plus /[b]/y the server prints Ready and exits with code 1 after 509 to 843 ms.
svg.text: JS ORCHESTRATOR · build() IN build/index.ts · SPANS IN SOURCE ORDER
left to right is source order; widths are not durations
INSIDE compile (:1889-2022) · EXACTLY ONE LANE RUNS
injectedClientEntries: the server compile decides which client entries exist
app/[a]/x + app/[b]/y: next build exits 0; next start throws in handleSlug
"✓ Ready", then 'a' !== 'b' and exit code 1 after 509–843 ms, before any request
Fill: blue reads app/ · green writes into .next/ · grey stays in memory or checks · white is the compiler branch · purple survives clean · red marks the slug-conflict gap.
Edges: thin blue = data · thick black = sequence · dashed purple = state carried forward. Orange = measured, 401-route Turbopack cold build, QUIET medians (n=3).
